notes.list_status: NOT certified. Alone among the 38, Peterborough had not updated its page three days after nominations closed: the heading still reads 'List of Uncertified Candidates' and the text below it still reads 'The nomination period is open until August 21 at 2 p.m.' A no-cache refetch on 2026-08-24 returned the same page, so this is the city's published state, not a stale copy. The linked /elections/candidates/ page confirms it, saying only that the list of uncertified candidates is posted on the Voters page. The names below are that list; a certified list should be re-collected when the city posts one.
notes.source_note: The layout changed since 2026-08-11: candidates are now paragraphs of the form 'Name: contact details' under an office heading, not table rows.
